proposal.blind_spot: Current metrics cannot distinguish a DRAM-saturated kernel at its roofline (where rewriting is futile or harmful) from a latency-limited kernel with too few resident warps stalled on global loads (where more occupancy/ILP, not fusion, is the fix).

rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> occupancy is adequate; only reduce bytes, and if traffic is already minimal leave the kernel unchanged / LOW -> increase occupancy via smaller blocks, retuned num_warps, and simpler indexing to hide latency and raise DRAM utilization
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> restructure to get more loads in flight (wider/vectorized loads, loads issued earlier, more independent per-thread work) / LOW -> kernel is bandwidth-saturated; avoid register- or instruction-adding rewrites that caused the observed regressions
